Callout.Name: Vehicle Break-In
Callout.Message: Person seen breaking into a parked car.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, window smashed, owner not on scene.

Script.Line: It is my car. The window is mine and the car is mine.
I locked the keys inside it. That is why the window is out.
Look at the registration. Go on, look at the registration.

Lines.Approach: He smashed the window and he is still at it. Owner is not with us yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
